people.text: Jane is planning a very small party for her friends, and wants it to be in a historic place. She would like a photographer to be provided.

Colin and Alison want to hire a whole building just for themselves and their guests. They'd like the place to have a professional party organiser to help them plan everything, including an excellent meal.
Alex and Diana would like to arrive at their party by boat, and they want somewhere without bright lights. They're looking for a place which has had good reviews.

Peter needs a place where elderly guests can move around without difficulty, which also offers accommodation. He wants the choice of having the party either indoors or outdoors, depending on the weather on the day.
Jenny and Robin want a place where they can bring food themselves, and where children can run around and have fun. Some of their guests will need help with transport to the party.

items.label: A
items.title: Hotel Homewood
items.text: Homewood is all on the ground floor, including guest bedrooms and all party facilities, to allow access for everyone. The beautiful hall will be available to you for your party, as well as the lovely gardens – watch boats go past on the river as you enjoy your celebration.

items.label: B
items.title: Murphy's
items.text: Murphy's will provide a party expert to help you arrange your event. You won't need to share the venue with anyone, as the place will be all yours for the day. Our experienced staff will have top - quality dishes and help keep young children entertained.

items.label: C
items.title: Bruton Hall
items.text: At Bruton Hall, you can choose from a range of options, depending on your budget. For example, you can hire one of our chefs for the day or do the cooking yourselves. Our party guests get discounts on accommodation at several local hotels, all of which have had really good reviews.

items.label: D
items.title: Waterford Hotel
items.text: Whether you want to let our chefs amaze you, or to provide your own refreshments, a party in this magnificent old building is an event to remember. Our staff can organise a taxi for anyone who requires one. We also have a fantastic playground for younger guests.

items.label: E
items.title: Kite Lodge
items.text: It's possible to sail to the front door of Kite Lodge in the historic harbour. Kite Lodge was built in 1537 and the party room is lit only by candles, which is perfect for amazing photos of your event. Look online to see all the positive comments about previous events held here.

items.label: F
items.title: The Priory Hotel
items.text: We have a team of staff to help with your celebration or event, including a prize - winning party planner, top chefs and our own photographer. We work hard to ensure that all guests, including kids and older visitors, have a fabulous time. There are 63 double bedrooms, all with easy access. So why not come and talk to us?

items.label: G
items.title: Freshford Farm
items.text: Set in gorgeous countryside, it can be hard to believe that the airport is just a 10 - minute drive away. Freshford Farm now has a specially built party hall, with glass walls allowing light in, so photos taken inside as though they were taken outside! And children will love seeing the farm animals on site.

items.label: H
items.title: Savernake House
items.text: The magnificent Savernake House dates back to the 16th century, and will look amazing in your party photos. We can even arrange for someone to take those for you, and capture the fantastic atmosphere! Unlike many places, we don't have a minimum number of guests.

explanations.6: Jane 想在历史悠久的地方举办小型派对，希望提供摄影师。H 选项 “Savernake House” 是 16 世纪的宏伟建筑，可安排摄影师捕捉派对氛围，且没有最低宾客人数限制，符合小型派对需求。原文提到 “Savernake House dates back to the 16th century... We can even arrange for someone to take those for you”，直接对应 “historic place” 和 “photographer provided”。
explanations.7: Colin 和 Alison 想租用整栋建筑，希望有专业派对组织者协助策划，包括提供美食。B 选项 “Murphy's” 会提供派对专家协助安排活动，场地全天专属，且有经验丰富的员工准备高品质菜肴，符合 “hire a whole building” 和 “professional party organiser” 的需求。原文 “Murphy's will provide a party expert... you won't need to share the venue... experienced staff will have top-quality dishes” 与需求完全匹配。
explanations.8: Alex 和 Diana 想乘船抵达派对地点，希望场地没有强光且有良好评价。E 选项 “Kite Lodge” 位于历史悠久的港口，可乘船抵达前门，派对房间仅用蜡烛照明，且网上有大量关于此前活动的正面评价，符合 “arrive by boat” 和 “without bright lights” 的要求。原文 “sail to the front door... lit only by candles... positive comments about previous events” 直接对应需求。
explanations.9: Peter 需要场地方便老年宾客活动，提供住宿，且可根据天气选择室内或室外举办派对。A 选项 “Hotel Homewood” 全部位于底层，包括客房和派对设施，方便所有人进出，有漂亮的大厅和花园，可根据天气选择场地，符合需求。原文 “all on the ground floor... beautiful hall... lovely gardens – watch boats go past” 对应 “elderly guests move around” 和 “indoor/outdoor choice”。
explanations.10: Jenny 和 Robin 想自带食物，让孩子自由活动，部分宾客需要交通帮助。D 选项 “Waterford Hotel” 允许自带茶点，有很棒的儿童游乐场，员工可为需要的人安排出租车，符合 “bring food themselves” 和 “children can run around” 的需求。原文 “provide your own refreshments... fantastic playground... organise a taxi for anyone who requires one” 直接满足条件。
